text: {"text":"Reviewing the proposed update, the relevant change is straightforward: it increases the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. The available evidence comes from a twenty-four-hour benchmark, which observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests. That reduction is operationally promising. However, the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence, so the evidence remains limited in one specific respect. Taken together, these results support a limited experiment but do not support broad rollout. The bounded recommendation is therefore to approve only a canary deployment and to require stale-read telemetry before considering any broader rollout."}
